scope: M5b delivery of Hull 11e GE section 26.13 plus the fixes for the independent review of 2026-09-16 (F1-F7).

suites.command: uv run --no-sync --package hullkit pytest -q johnhull/hullkit/tests johnhull/report/tests

asian_tests.skipped: none: the two r=q skips became two-sided limit checks

defects_found_on_the_real_screens: Portal: the four cards were half width, so the three-line note was clipped and overlapped the legend. Fixed with a full-row rule in report/assets/style.css.
Book: the single-line titles were clipped in the narrower column. Fixed by breaking each title after the market label.

Both: two of the six market lines shared a colour because the portal theme remaps #2ca02c onto its gray #86868b. Fixed with a six-colour sequence that stays distinct after that remap, and a colour-collision check in the browser script.
claims_corrected_against_measurement: The figure note, the notebook text and the portal caption said the simulated skewness was smaller than the fitted lognormal's. It is larger in all three markets (0.099/0.088, 0.420/0.356, 9.543/6.721).
The notebook and the figure note claimed the error is high above M1 and low below it. The measured 52-observation pattern is different and is now stated as measured.
pinning_note: 状態件数をassertするテストは検証記録にpinしない。report/tests/test_section_ledger.py and report/tests/test_report_build.py assert section and figure counts, so registering the next section would invalidate this record for no real reason.
independent_review: Not performed. The ledger state stays pending_validation, not accepted.

review_response.verdict_received: requires changes: 6 P2 findings and 1 P3
review_response.F1: The continuous r=q case is a removable singularity the implementation evaluates; the notebook says so and two skipped tests became two-sided limit checks.
review_response.F2: The 5 points whose difference is inside 4 standard errors are drawn as x markers and counted in the note; the 'far smaller than the error' claim is gone.
review_response.F3: The headline range is stated as the 119 rows above 0.5, with the 17 cheaper rows (+20.44% / -18.29%) and the 8 zero-reference rows separated in the record, the teaching text, the acceptance note and the roadmap.
review_response.F4: The refuted direction rule was removed from the docstring, the generator and numerical-check.json.
review_response.F5: The evidence and the displayed table are now the same contract (Hull Example 26.3 seasoned, averages 40/50/60/90), and the browser check compares every displayed cell with an independent reference.
review_response.F6: The falling-price statement is limited to the ATM call example with a counterexample, and the geometric bound is stated per contract.
review_response.F7: A single observation at maturity now returns exactly 0.0, checked across the six markets for both contracts, with the collapsing-window limit checked for its sqrt scaling.
